head: #[#set std.raw(lang: none, theme: none);#show std.raw: it => { set std.text(font: ("DejaVu Sans Mono", "Noto Serif CJK SC"), size: 11pt, weight: 400, style: "normal", tracking: 0pt, ligatures: false, dir: ltr, lang: "en", hyphenate: false, fill: std.rgb("#1f1f1f")); let body = it.lines.map(line => line.body).join(std.linebreak()); if it.block { set std.par(justify: false, leading: 0.64em); std.block(width: 100%, breakable: true, fill: white, stroke: none, radius: 0pt, inset: (x: 0pt, y: 2pt), above: 0.4em, below: 0.4em, body) } else { std.highlight(fill: white, radius: 0pt, extent: 0pt, body) } };
formulaHead: #[#set std.raw(lang: none, theme: none);#show std.raw: it => { set std.text(font: ("DejaVu Sans Mono", "Noto Serif CJK SC"), size: 11pt, weight: 400, style: "normal", tracking: 0pt, ligatures: false, dir: ltr, lang: "en", hyphenate: false, fill: std.rgb("#1f1f1f")); let body = it.lines.map(line => line.body).join(std.linebreak()); if it.block { set std.par(justify: false, leading: 0.64em); std.block(width: 100%, breakable: true, fill: white, stroke: none, radius: 0pt, inset: (x: 0pt, y: 2pt), above: 0.4em, below: 0.4em, body) } else { std.highlight(fill: white, radius: 0pt, extent: 0pt, body) } };
previewTail: ];#context { let size = std.measure(body); std.box(width: 0pt, height: 0pt)[#std.box(width: size.width, height: size.height)[#body] <_typstpad_formula_preview>] }]
outputTail: ];#context { let size = std.measure(body); std.box(width: 0pt, height: 0pt)[#std.box(width: size.width, height: size.height)[#body] <_typstpad_expansion_output>] }]
